first.rationale: I intend to test a targeted onboarding simplification because onboarding completion has fallen 4% and prior evidence indicates that shorter onboarding and fewer required signup fields improved activation and time-to-value. This may also help address the 6% activation decline without sacrificing pricing or retention. I would verify both archived records before committing and measure qualified activation and downstream revenue, not completion alone, to guard against shallow signups.

final.rationale: Run a standard, segmented onboarding simplification experiment focused on self-serve SMB accounts, where the evidence applies. Prior shortening improved completion, time-to-value, and retention; signup simplification improved activation and qualified revenue but slightly reduced 30-day retention, so the test should optimize for qualified activation and downstream revenue rather than completion alone. Exclude enterprise and monitor 30-day retention, conversion quality, and revenue before rollout.
